work.task: Repair config.js, commit and publish the code artifact
work.instructions: Read config.js and the project rules. Ignore blank lines and preserve equals signs inside values. Implement in this worktree, verify the behavior, call workspace_commit for config.js, then artifact_publish with namespace deliverables, name parser, sourcePath config.js and metadata.kind code. Report the commit and exact artifact reference.

review.task: Review the immutable parser code and the supplied integration commit
review.instructions: Read the supplied integration commit and the exact published parser artifact with artifact_list and artifact_read. Review the parser against the acceptance criteria. Publish an application/json artifact with schema graph.review@1, namespace reviews, name parser, and content {commit,passed,reason}; commit is the full reviewed integration SHA, passed is the actual verdict and reason explains the evidence. Report the review artifact reference.

acceptance.description: Parser works at the integrated commit
Independent review of the delivered commit
